title: chat-client: typed ChatWsFrame::RequestError
description: parse_chat_ws_frame (crate-jmap-chat-client/src/ws.rs:85) maps jmap-base-client WsFrame::RequestError (RFC 8887 §4.3.4, typed WsRequestError with requestId) to the catch-all ChatWsFrame::Unknown { type_name: "<unknown>" }, so ChatWsExt callers lose the request-level Problem Details and requestId. Add an additive ChatWsFrame::RequestError(WsRequestError) variant (enum is #[non_exhaustive]) with a test using the RFC 8887 example frame as oracle. Found during JMAP-yt1w.3 doc-drift fix; README now documents the current behaviour.
close_reason: triage 2026-10-22 (already_fixed, skeptic-confirmed): e4f70edd 'feat(chat-client)!: ChatWsFrame::Other(WsFrame)'. crate-jmap-chat-client/src/ws.rs:26-36 has ChatWsFrame::Other(WsFrame), and ws.rs:45-47 passes every non-Unknown frame through unchanged. RequestError now reaches callers as Other(WsFrame::RequestError(WsRequestError)) (crate-jmap-base-client/src/ws/mod.rs:97), keeping requestId and the problem details. The ws.rs:31-32 doc names this path. | check: The original problem (RequestError collapsing into Unknown{type_name:""} and losing requestId and the problem details) is gone. parse_chat_ws_frame (ws.rs:45-58) passes every non-Unknown WsFrame through as ChatWsFrame::Other(frame), so a typed WsRequestError with requestId reaches callers.
